name: Transnistria
facts: No UN member states; only Abkhazia and South Ossetia

flag.description: Horizontal red, green and red bands in a 3:2:3 ratio, with a gold hammer and sickle beneath a gold-edged red star in the upper hoist.
flag.symbolism: The design copies the flag of the Soviet-era Moldavian SSR, from which Transnistria broke away; the flag law gives its symbols and colors no official meaning.

hook: Transnistria still flies the Soviet hammer and sickle: gold, under a red star, in the corner of a red flag with a green band across the middle.
trivia: The reverse of the state flag leaves out the hammer, sickle and star, and anyone except government bodies may fly that plain version instead.
The flag of Russia has equal legal status with the state flag in Transnistria.
